name: @bronsonhill/conman
description: Deterministic, offline linter for a repository's Claude Code context stack: load order, token cost, duplication, value conflicts, and a budget-gated CI check.

scripts.test:update-golden: npm run build && UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 node --test test/run-golden.js
scripts.test:corpus: npm run build && scripts/fetch-fixtures.sh llm ack-nestjs-boilerplate firstmate humanlayer motrix && node --test test/corpus-sweep.js
scripts.test:corpus:all: npm run build && scripts/fetch-fixtures.sh && CONMAN_CORPUS_REQUIRE_ALL=1 node --test test/corpus-sweep.js
scripts.test:corpus:update: npm run build && scripts/fetch-fixtures.sh && UPDATE_CORPUS_DIGEST=1 node --test test/corpus-sweep.js
